name: nda-register
description: The Network Decentralization Authority's register: membership applications from the create-fc microsite, member numbers, and member card images. A Cloudflare Worker with a D1 database.

scripts.claims: wrangler d1 execute nda-register --local --command "SELECT id, name, node, payout, created_at FROM members WHERE payout IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id"
scripts.claims:remote: wrangler d1 execute nda-register --remote --command "SELECT id, name, node, payout, created_at FROM members WHERE payout IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id"
